svg.text: App servers 06–08: the connections I checked
Each app script: one EC2 (roboshop.sh) → git clone → bash 0N-<app>.sh → health / journal / telnet proves the outgoing calls
Every arrow uses a DNS name (<server>.abhignadevops.store) set in the app's .service file via sed, and a target SG rule that allows the caller's SG.
